from collections import deque
def shortest(g,start,end):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    def ok(i,j): return 0<=i<H and 0<=j<W and g[i][j]==0
    seen={start}; q=deque([(start,0)]); par={}
    while q:
        cur,n=q.popleft()
        if cur==end: break
        i,j=cur
        for di,dj in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            n2=n+1
            ni,nj=i+di,j+dj
            if ok(ni,nj) and (ni,nj) not in seen:
                seen.add((ni,nj)); par[(ni,nj)]=cur; q.append(((ni,nj),n2))
    # reconstruct
    path=[]
    c=end
    while c!=start:
        path.append(c); c=par[c]
    path.sort()
    return path

    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    def horiz(pts): return len({i for i,_ in pts})==1
    tset=set(tw)|set(th)
    if horiz(tw) and horiz(th):
        r2=c2s=min(j for _,j in tw); c2e=max(j for _,j in tw)
        r3,c3s=min(j for _,j in th),max(j for _,j in th)
        top,bot=sorted((r2,r3))

            if not okv: continue
            e = c2s-1 if bendc<c2s else c2e+1
            okh=all(0<=c<W and g[r2][c]==0 for c in range(min(e,bendc),max(e,bendc)+1))
            if not okh: continue
            seg={(r,c) for r,c in [(r2,c) for c in range(min(e,bendc),max(e,bendc)+1)]} | \

            d = c2s-1 if bender<c2s else c2e+1
            okh=all(0<=c<W and g[bender][c]==0 for c in range(min(d,bender),max(d,bender)+1))
            if not okh: continue
            okv=all(0<=i<H and 0<=l_c<W and g[i][l_c]==0 for i in range(l+1,r) if False) if False else None
            # vertical corridors along each object's column from their ends to the bender row
            vA=all(0<=i<H and g[i][c2]==0 for i in range(c2s+1 if False else min(c2s,bender),max(c2s,bender)+1) )
            vB=all(0<=i<H and g[i][c3]==0 for i in range(min(c3s,bender),max(c3s,bender)+1) )
            if not (vA and vB): continue
            seg={(i,c2) for i in range(min(c2s,bender),max(c2s,bender)+1)} | \
                {(i,c3) for i in range(min(c3s,bender),max(c3s,bender)+1)} | \
                {(bender,c) for c in range(min(d,bender),max(d,bender)+1)}
            if best is None or len(seg)<len(best): best=seg
        if not best: return out
        for i,j in best: out[i][j]=3
    return out

        sR=candsR=None
        # scan rows adjacent outside the object group
        for sR in range(H):

        # candidates: r3lo-1 (above) and r3hi+1 (below), whichever clear
        for candS in (r3lo-1, r3hi+1):
            if not (0<=candS<H): continue
            # column corridors along each bar from bar to candS inclusive
            for col,name in ((c2,'A'),(c3,'B')):
                rng=range(min(col,candS),max(col,candS)+1)
                if not all(clear(i,col) for i in rng): continue
            for cc in (c2,c3):
                rng=range(min(cc,candS),max(cc,candS)+1)
                if not all(clear(i,cc) for i in rng): continue
            hr=range(min(c2,c3),max(c2,c3)+1)
            if not all(clear(candS,cc) for cc in hr): continue
            seg={(i,c2) for i in range(min(r2lo,candS),max(r2hi,candS)+1)} | \
                {(i,c3) for i in range(min(r3lo,candS),max(r3hi,candS)+1)} | \
                {(candS,cc) for cc in hr}
            cands.append((len(seg),seg))
    if not cands: return out
    _,seg=min(cands)
    for i,j in seg: out[i][j]=3
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    p=solve(G[k+' input']); mo=G[k+' output']

            seg|={(x,c2) for x in rng2}

def candidates(k):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {k} input'];go=G[f'Demo pair {k} output']
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    bgc=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    def noise(i,j): return 0<=i<H and 0<=j<W and gi[i][j]!=bgc and not (gi[i][j]==3 or gi[i][j]==2)
    tw=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(gi) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==2]
    th=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(gi) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==3]
    p=set((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if go[i][j]==3 and gi[i][j]!=3)
    # hypothesis: path cells never adjacent (8-nb) to a noise cell; also path must lie in rows/cols swept by...
    def adj_noise(cell):
        i,j=cell;return any(noise(i+di,j+dj) for di in(-1,0,1) for dj in(-1,0,1) if (di,dj)!=(0,0))
    # expected path clear of noise adjacency?
    clean=all(not adj_noise(c) for c in p)
    return clean,noise,p

# fix BFS with proper tie-break: fewer turns then fewer cells; also stop goal is first 3-bar cell reachable in tie-break order
from collections import deque,Counter
import heapq
def solve(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    bgc=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    def free(i,j): return 0<=i<H and 0<=j<W and gi[i][j]==bgc
    DIRS=[(1,0),(0,1),(0,-1),(-1,0)]
    tw=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(gi) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==2]
    th=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(gi) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==3]
    ftn=lambda d,b:(b,d); fst=lambda d,b:(d,b)
    K=ftn
    dist={s:K(0,0) for s in tw}; prev={}; heap=[]
    for s in tw: heapq.heappush(heap,(0,0,s))
    while heap:
        _,k,c=heapq.heappop(heap)
        dd,dn=dist.get(c,(999,999))
        if k>K(dd,dn): continue
        for di,dj in DIRS:
            n=(c[0]+di,c[1]+dj)
            if not free(*n): continue
            nb=dn+(1 if (di!=0)!=(dj!=0) else 0)
            nk=K(nb,dn+1)
            if nk<K(dist.get(n,(999,999))):
                dist[n]=nk; prev[n]=c; heapq.heappush(heap,(nk[0],nk[1],n))
    best=None;p=None
    for g in th:
        for n in ((g[0]+1,g[1]),(g[0]-1,g[1]),(g[0],g[1]+1),(g[0],g[1]-1)):
            if n in dist:
                if best is None or dist[n]<best:
                    best=dist[n];p=n
    path=[];cur=p
    while cur is not None:
        path.append(cur);cur=prev[cur]
    out=[r[:] for r in gi]
    for i,j in path:
        if gi[i][j]!=3: out[i][j]=3
    return out,path,dist[p],p
for k in range(1,9):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {k} input'];go=G[f'Demo pair {k} output']
    o,pp,c,p=solve(gi)
    print(k,'match' if o==go else 'mismatch','cost',c,'turns',pp[0] and len([1 for a,b in zip(pp,pp[1:]) if a[0]!=b[0] and a[1]!=b[1]]) )

import collections
def analyze(k):
    gi,go=G8[f'Demo pair {k} input'],G8[f'Demo pair {k} output']
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in gi for v in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    src=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if gi[r][c]==3]
    tgt=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if gi[r][c]==2]
    ch=set((r,c) for r,c,a,b in diffs(gi,go) if b==3)
    all3=src+list(ch)
    def ddict():
        dd={s:0 for s in src}; par={}; q=collections.deque(src)
        while q:
            x=q.popleft()
            for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                y=(x[0]+dr,x[1]+dc)
                if 0<=y[0]<H and 0<=y[1]<W and gi[y[0]][y[1]]!=bg and y not in dd:
                    dd[y]=dd[x]+1; par[y]=x; q.append(y)
        return dd
    dd=ddict()
    ends=[e for e in all3 if len([(dr,dc) for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)) if (e[0]+dr,e[1]+dc) in tgt])==1]
    # target = the 2 cell adjacent to an end via straight line along path
    print('pair',k,'bg',bg,'seed',sorted(src),'2s',tgt)
    for e in ends:
        t2=[t for t in tgt if abs(t[0]-e[0])+abs(t[1]-e[1])==1]
        if t2:
            t=t2[0]
            # reconstruct path from seed to e
            p=[];x=e
            while x not in src: x=dd.get(x,None); p.insert(0,x)
            print('  end',e,'->2 at',t,'| dist',dd.get(e,99), '| cells on path & changed:',sum(1 for c_ in p if c_ in ch))
            print('    added path cells:',sorted(set(p)))
    for m in sorted(dd,key=lambda z:(z[0]*z[1]))[:6]: print('   sample dist',m,d[d[m]])
